title: Add extended badge criteria to admin tab and reverse leaderboard date sort

requirements.summary: Extend the badge creation form in the Admin tab to support 12 additional criteria types (totalDaysAvailable, totalGamesPlayed, firstMatchLogged, winPercentage, bestWinStreak, totalChatMessages, totalLikesReceived, firstImageUploaded, topLeaderboardPosition, daysAtNumber1, monthlyParticipation, consecutiveWeeksAvailable) alongside the existing criteria types (totalWins, winsStreak, totalGames).
acceptanceCriteria: The badge creation/edit modal in the Admin tab displays all 12 new criteria types in the criteria type dropdown alongside the existing ones.
Selecting any new criteria type shows an appropriate threshold/value input field.
The backend BadgeCriteria type is extended to include all new criteria variants.
Existing badge creation with totalWins, winsStreak, and totalGames still works correctly.
New criteria types are persisted and displayed correctly when viewing existing badges.

file_operations.description: Extend the badge criteria type dropdown to include all 12 new criteria variants: totalDaysAvailable, totalGamesPlayed, firstMatchLogged, winPercentage, bestWinStreak, totalChatMessages, totalLikesReceived, firstImageUploaded, topLeaderboardPosition, daysAtNumber1, monthlyParticipation, and consecutiveWeeksAvailable. Update the form state and validation logic to handle the new criteria types with appropriate threshold input fields. For monthlyParticipation, add fields for year, month, and matchesThreshold. Ensure existing criteria types (totalWins, winsStreak, totalGames) remain unchanged and functional. Update the criteria display logic to show human-readable labels for all criteria types. The backend interface already includes the extended BadgeCriteria type variants, so ensure the frontend properly maps to and from these backend types when creating, editing, and displaying badges.

requirements.summary: Reverse the sort order of dates in the Leaderboard page date dropdown so that the most recent dates appear at the top and the oldest dates appear at the bottom.
acceptanceCriteria: The date dropdown in the Leaderboard tab lists dates in descending order (newest first, oldest last).
The previously selected or default date still resolves correctly after the sort is reversed.
No other leaderboard functionality is affected.

file_operations.description: Locate the date dropdown component that allows users to select a date for adding wins or losses. Reverse the sort order of the dates array so that the most recent dates appear first (descending order) and the oldest dates appear last. Ensure the currently selected date or default date logic remains functional after the sort order change. Verify that the win/loss recording functionality and all other leaderboard features continue to work correctly with the new sort order.
